en.headline: OASES welcomes seventh batch of 18 strategic enterprises
en.dek: The firms are expected to add to a cumulative HK$84 billion in investment and about 27,000 jobs from 142 strategic partners to date.
body: The Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises announced a seventh batch of 18 strategic enterprises on Thursday at a signing ceremony, with Financial Secretary Paul Chan hosting the event.

About half the new partners are from mainland China and half from elsewhere, covering advanced manufacturing, new energy, artificial intelligence, life and health technology, fintech and cultural and creative technology. Several have market capitalisations or valuations exceeding HK$100 billion, Chan said.

Together with earlier batches, the 142 strategic enterprises are expected to bring in some HK$84 billion in investments and create about 27,000 jobs over the coming years. Chan said the companies would help drive innovation and economic growth, and that Hong Kong would use its financial strengths to help them secure capital.

Director-General Peter Yan said the new firms would help the city retain research and development talent. One firm plans to establish its Asia-Pacific headquarters and invest HK$200 million to HK$300 million, while a precious-metal refiner intends to set up a gold refinery in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 引進辦公布第七批18家重點企業
zh.dek: 連同過往批次，142家重點企業預計帶來約840億港元投資及約2.7萬個職位。
body: 引進重點企業辦公室周四舉行簽署儀式，公布第七批18家重點企業，財政司司長陳茂波主持儀式。
新一批企業約一半來自內地，一半來自其他地方，涵蓋先進製造、新能源、人工智能、生命健康科技、金融科技及文化創意科技等領域。陳茂波表示，當中數家企業市值或估值超過1000億港元。
連同較早批次，至今142家重點企業預計未來數年帶來約840億港元投資，創造約2.7萬個職位。陳茂波指這些企業有助推動創新及經濟發展，香港會發揮金融優勢協助它們融資。
引進辦主任任景信表示，新企業有助本港留住研發人才。有企業計劃在港設立亞太總部，未來數年投資2億至3億港元；另有貴金屬精煉商打算在港設立煉金廠。
